rule: Integration and job statuses are OPERATIONAL. They are visible to administrators on SCR-26, SCR-38 and SCR-39. They must NEVER be rendered on a business screen as if they were C3 business statuses. A contract test enforces this.
relationship_to_C3: Disjoint, with one deliberate exception: C3 contains INTEGRATION_FAILED and RECONCILIATION_PENDING, which are the two business-visible consequences of integration state. Those two C3 codes are the ONLY sanctioned bridge from this namespace to a business screen.

business_visible_bridge.note: Objects carry a separate integration_state badge alongside their C3 business status, rather than adding a 22nd business status. This is precisely why the registries are separated.

derivation.QUEUED: an integration_outbox row exists for this object in state PENDING
derivation.SENT: outbox row in state SENT and external_id populated
derivation.FAILED: outbox row in state FAILED or DEAD -> also sets C3 business status INTEGRATION_FAILED

statuses.meaning: Could not be attributed or mapped. Raised a reconciliation_exception. NEVER guessed, never spread pro-rata, never dropped.
Duplicate payload_sha for an already-processed external_id. Idempotent no-op.
Exceeded max_attempts. Visible on SCR-39 with manual retry.
Enqueued inside the business transaction. Not yet sent.
Retryable failure. next_attempt_at set with exponential backoff and full jitter.

job.description: One bounded, chunked, checkpointed background job. Ceiling 15 minutes on Catalyst Cron/Event Functions; soft deadline 12 minutes.

statuses.meaning: Claimed via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. locked_until set for crash reaping.
Soft deadline reached; progress committed and a resumable cursor persisted. Resumes on the next tick.
Exceeded max_attempts or max_resume_count. Alerts rather than looping forever.
5 consecutive counted failures in 60s, or daily quota exhausted. No calls attempted until next_probe_at.
A single probe call is permitted. Success closes; failure reopens.

circuit.naming_note: Prefixed CIRCUIT_ deliberately. The bare code CLOSED collides with the C3 business status CLOSED, and the two mean opposite things - a closed circuit is healthy and passing traffic, whereas a closed project is terminal and blocks posting. The collision was caught by tests/test_contracts.py::test_integration_statuses_are_disjoint_from_business_statuses on first run.

rate_limit_classification.note: Zoho error codes are handled distinctly. Only genuine vendor failures count toward the circuit breaker.

429_code_44_per_minute.reason: our own throttle failed, not the vendor

429_code_45_daily_quota.action: open circuit until next day boundary, alert

429_code_1070_concurrency.action: reduce parallelism by 1, retry with jitter

401_invalid_token.action: refresh once; second failure opens circuit and raises P1

4xx_business_error.action: no retry; QUARANTINED or DEAD plus a reconciliation_exception
